_comment: Wall-clock budgets in seconds per `test:*` suite, checked by
scripts/check-suite-budgets.mjs at the end of `pnpm test`.
Raise a number only with a recorded measurement in the commit
message — this file is the ratchet that keeps a twenty-minute suite
from growing back one reasonable-looking test at a time. AGENTS.md
has the cheaper places to put a new assertion.
Budgets are ~30% above the slowest observed IN-CHAIN run, not above
the suite measured alone. The distinction matters and cost round 2 a
red gate: run on its own, qa-orchestration is 35.3 / 35.8 / 35.8s,
but inside `pnpm test` the same suite measured 35.4s and then 51.8s.
A suite measured alone is stable to about 2%; the same suite inside
the chain can land 45% higher. `scripts/timed-suite.mjs` reads the
in-chain number, so that is what a budget has to cover — a gate that
trips on ordinary variance just teaches people to raise it.
NOTE on the 2026-08-26 round-2 drop: most of it came from making
fixture repos ignore the host git configuration (see the comment in
vitest.config.ts). A machine-wide `core.hooksPath` was running a
third-party hook on every fixture commit, checkout and merge. These
budgets therefore assume no such hook runs. On a host that never had
one the numbers were always lower, and the budgets are still met.

_measured2026_08_26_round1._total: 624.5s of suite time, 10m30s of `pnpm test`, 765 tests

_measured2026_08_26_round2._note: Two full-chain runs; each entry is the slower of the two.
_measured2026_08_26_round2._total: 410.5s then 437.2s of suite time; 6m56s and 7m23s of `pnpm test`, 765 tests
_measured2026_08_26_round2._alone: Measured alone, same machine: wave 96.4-99.0, git (inside fast) 49.0, qa 35.3-35.8, resume 40.8-43.1

_note: Round 3: orchestrator, wave and resume-integration each split into
two test files balanced by measured describe-block time, so one
`test:heavy:<name>` invocation schedules both across the two
workers. Full chain, same day but with an agent session resident
(alone-runs that day were ~40% above the round-2 record, so these
in-chain numbers are conservative). Paired alone-runs, idle-ish:
_measured2026_08_26_round3._total: 411.9s of suite time, 6m56s of `pnpm test`, 765 tests

_note: Full chain on main at fbe98ac (PRs #116 + #117 merged, 803 tests),
idle machine. fast tripped its 79s budget at 81.6s with no new
slow test — the wave-1 PRs added ~0.15s to fast. Alone-runs the
same day: 75.2 (idle, straight after the chain) and 84.1 (s7
worktree, agent session resident). The observed band 75-84s
straddled the 79s budget, so the budget sat inside ordinary
variance; raised to 90 per the ~30%-above-in-chain rule above.
